command:
set +e
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
mkdir -p out
T0=$(date +%s)
grep -E ' (gtdb-rs226-reps\.k31\.sig\.zip|gtdb-rs226-reps\.lineages\.csv|run\.py|score\.py|zymo\.tsv|ERR2984773_[12]\.fastq\.gz|ERR2935805_[12]\.fastq\.gz)$' pins.sha256 > pins.sel
[ "$(wc -l < pins.sel)" -eq 9 ] && sha256sum -c pins.sel > out/pins-check.txt 2>&1 || { cat out/pins-check.txt; echo "FAIL: a staged input does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
echo "pins_check_s $(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))" | tee out/pins-time.txt
{
  echo "uname_m $(uname -m)"
  echo "online_cpus $(grep -c '^processor' /proc/cpuinfo)"
  echo "physical_cores $(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/topology/thread_siblings_list | sort -u | wc -l)"
  awk -F': *' '/^model name|^CPU part|^CPU implementer/{print $1": "$2}' /proc/cpuinfo | sort | uniq -c
  echo "mem_total_kib $(awk '/^MemTotal/{print $2}' /proc/meminfo)"
  echo "sourmash $(sourmash --version 2>&1 | tail -1)"
  python3 --version
} > out/host.txt 2>&1
awk '/^online_cpus/{c=$2} /^physical_cores/{p=$2} END{printf "threads_per_core %d\n", (p>0)?c/p:0}' out/host.txt >> out/host.txt
cat out/host.txt
python3 -u run.py /tmp/out gtdb-rs226-reps.k31.sig.zip gtdb-rs226-reps.lineages.csv zymo.tsv ERR2984773:even ERR2935805:log 2>&1 | tee out/run.log
RC=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
df -m /tmp | tee -a out/run.log
echo "cgroup_memory_peak_bytes $(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak 2>/dev/null)" | tee -a out/run.log
[ "$RC" = 0 ] || { echo "FAIL: run.py exit $RC"; exit 1; }
echo DONE
